verdict.rationale: Weave documents offline evaluations built on an Evaluation object that takes a Dataset plus scorers, and its marketing says you can test new LLMs and custom models against production traces. However, nothing in the pack shows a workflow for curating or building a Dataset from captured traces, such as selecting calls and adding them to a dataset. Missing for 10: documented trace-to-dataset curation workflow, dataset versioning or editing from traces, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can curate datasets from production traces and run offline evaluations against them

citations.quote: the core of the workflow is the _`Evaluation` object_, which defines: A `Dataset` or list of dictionaries for test examples. One or more scoring functions.
You can test new LLMs and custom models against production traces, assessing their performance for your specific use cases.
measure your LLM application’s performance against repeatable test cases, compare changes over time, and identify regressions.
